verdicts.reason: A keeps the bottle in its cream circle and has a strong headline. Its flaws are a stray faint circle clipped at the top-left corner, NEW and Try It pills of different widths that only share a right edge, and a large empty lower-left area. B separates the cream circle from the bottle and drops it behind the 'B' of the headline, which is a clear unwanted collision. B also turns the pill buttons into squared rectangles, losing the brand shape, and staggers NEW and Try It so they share no edge or axis.
